bullets.text: Governor Rajendra Vishwanath Arlekar presented Unit Citations to Air Force Station Avadi and the 27 Special Composite Group of the National Security Guard in Chennai on Wednesday.
The office should acknowledge the recognition given to Air Force Station Avadi and the NSG group by the Governor and monitor any related security events in the district.

stories.title: Governor presents Unit Citations to Air Force Station, Avadi, 27 Special Composite Group of National Security Guard
takeaways: Governor Rajendra Vishwanath Arlekar awarded Unit Citations to Air Force Station Avadi and the NSG group.
The event highlights military excellence and security preparedness within the Thiruvallur district administrative region.
